description.en: Streaming Zipformer transducer keyword spotting from sherpa-onnx model exports.
description.zh: 来自 sherpa-onnx 模型导出的流式 Zipformer transducer 关键词检测。

keywords.en: Newline- or slash-separated tokenized keyword rows; each row may include :score, #threshold, and @label fields.
keywords.zh: 换行或斜杠分隔的 token 化关键词行；每行可包含 :score、#threshold 和 @label 字段。

keywords_score.en: Default context score added for each matched keyword token. Negative values are accepted but token scores are clamped to at least zero.
keywords_score.zh: 每个匹配关键词 token 默认添加的上下文分数。接受负值，但 token 分数会被钳制到至少 0。

keywords_threshold.en: Default mean acoustic probability required to trigger a keyword.
keywords_threshold.zh: 触发关键词所需的平均声学概率。

num_trailing_blanks.en: Emit after strictly more than this many trailing blank frames; 1 requires 2 blanks, 0 requires 1.
num_trailing_blanks.zh: 严格超过该数量的尾部空白帧后发射；1 需要 2 个空白，0 需要 1 个。

licenses.name: Apache-2.0
licenses.notes: Default Chinese-English checkpoint; model author confirmed the license (https://github.com/k2-fsa/sherpa-onnx/issues/3802#issuecomment-6052663364). Other user-supplied exports may have different terms.
